content:
# SGP1-DO-VPS 路由器版 Clash 配置（OpenClash / mihomo 内核）
# 导入：OpenClash → 配置文件管理 → 上传 → 启用
# 管理系统订阅生成器必须以本文件为黄金模板（规则顺序不得改乱）。
#
# 分流铁律（省 VPS 流量，硬性）：
#   国内网站 / App / 视频 / 直播 = 直连运营商
#   只有境外站走 VPS
# 注意：
# 1. external-controller 默认只绑本机。OpenClash「外部控制」开关会覆盖，以插件设置为准。
# 2. 节点是 IP 直连，不依赖境外 DNS；fake-ip 防止污染 IP 被 GEOIP,CN 误判直连。

mixed-port: 7890
allow-lan: true
bind-address: "*"
mode: rule
# ---- runtime additions (managed directly, not via OpenClash) ----
redir-port: 7892
allow-lan: true
bind-address: "*"
external-controller: 0.0.0.0:9090
secret: "mgmt-rt-2026"
log-level: info
ipv6: false
unified-delay: true
tcp-concurrent: true
keep-alive-interval: 15
find-process-mode: off
external-controller: 127.0.0.1:9090

profile:
  store-selected: true
  store-fake-ip: true

sniffer:
  enable: true
  parse-pure-ip: true
  override-destination: false
  sniff:
    HTTP:
      ports: [80, 8080-8880]
    TLS:
      ports: [443, 8443]

dns:
  enable: true
  listen: 0.0.0.0:1053
  ipv6: false
  enhanced-mode: fake-ip
  fake-ip-range: 198.18.0.1/16
  fake-ip-filter:
    - "*.lan"
    - "*.local"
    - localhost
    - "+.msftconnecttest.com"
    - "+.msftncsi.com"
    - "time.*.com"
    - "ntp.*.com"
    - "stun.*.*"
  default-nameserver:
    - 223.5.5.5
    - 119.29.29.29
  nameserver:
    - https://doh.pub/dns-query
    - https://dns.alidns.com/dns-query
  fallback:
    - https://dns.google/dns-query
    - https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query
  fallback-filter:
    geoip: true
    geoip-code: CN
    ipcidr:
      - 240.0.0.0/4
    domain:
      - "+.google.com"
      - "+.googleapis.com"
      - "+.gstatic.com"
      - "+.youtube.com"
      - "+.github.com"
      - "+.telegram.org"
  proxy-server-nameserver:
    - 223.5.5.5
    - 8.8.8.8
  nameserver-policy:
    "geosite:cn,private":
      - https://doh.pub/dns-query
      - https://dns.alidns.com/dns-query

proxies:
  - name: "SGP1-DO-VPS"
    type: vless
    server: 159.223.36.119
    port: 443
    uuid: 69bd2ea4-d11d-4f87-aa6a-f93e6a866004
    network: tcp
    udp: true
    tls: true
    flow: xtls-rprx-vision
    servername: www.microsoft.com
    client-fingerprint: chrome
    reality-opts:
      public-key: cWCet6oRi_RqI_MAQlCMwynCOcOkS6galBYqVN-xiW0
      short-id: ed23a4f80e511729

proxy-groups:
  - name: "PROXY"
    type: select
    proxies:
      - AUTO
      - SGP1-DO-VPS
      - DIRECT
  - name: "AUTO"
    type: url-test
    url: https://www.gstatic.com/generate_204
    interval: 300
    tolerance: 80
    proxies:
      - SGP1-DO-VPS
  - name: "CN-MEDIA"
    type: select
    proxies:
      - DIRECT
  - name: "DOWNLOAD"
    type: select
    proxies:
      - DIRECT
      - PROXY

rules:
  - IP-CIDR,159.223.36.119/32,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - GEOIP,private,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - IP-CIDR,192.168.0.0/16,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - IP-CIDR,10.0.0.0/8,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - IP-CIDR,172.16.0.0/12,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - IP-CIDR,100.64.0.0/10,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - IP-CIDR,169.254.0.0/16,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - IP-CIDR6,fc00::/7,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - IP-CIDR6,fe80::/10,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - GEOSITE,private,DIRECT

  # 国内视频/短视频/直播 —— 禁止走节点
  - GEOSITE,bilibili,CN-MEDIA
  - GEOSITE,iqiyi,CN-MEDIA
  - GEOSITE,youku,CN-MEDIA
  - GEOSITE,bytedance,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,bilivideo.com,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,hdslb.com,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,iqiyi.com,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,iqiyipic.com,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,youku.com,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,ykimg.com,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,v.qq.com,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,video.qq.com,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,mgtv.com,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,hitv.com,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,douyin.com,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,douyinvod.com,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,amemv.com,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,byteimg.com,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,ixigua.com,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,kuaishou.com,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,yximgs.com,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,xiaohongshu.com,CN-MEDIA
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,xhscdn.com,CN-MEDIA

  # 国内互联网
  - GEOSITE,tencent,DIRECT
  - GEOSITE,alibaba,DIRECT
  - GEOSITE,baidu,DIRECT
  - GEOSITE,netease,DIRECT
  - GEOSITE,xiaomi,DIRECT
  - GEOSITE,apple-cn,DIRECT
  - GEOSITE,google-cn,DIRECT
  - GEOSITE,category-games@cn,DIRECT
  - GEOSITE,cn,DIRECT
  - GEOIP,CN,DIRECT,no-resolve

  # 大流量下载默认直连（省钱）；商店打不开再把 DOWNLOAD 切到 PROXY
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,steamcontent.com,DOWNLOAD
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,steamserver.net,DOWNLOAD
  - DOMAIN-KEYWORD,steampipe,DOWNLOAD
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,windowsupdate.com,DOWNLOAD
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,update.microsoft.com,DOWNLOAD
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,dl.delivery.mp.microsoft.com,DOWNLOAD
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,swcdn.apple.com,DOWNLOAD

  - AND,((NETWORK,UDP),(DST-PORT,443)),REJECT
  - MATCH,PROXY
